records.question: Mình muốn tìm internship AI Engineer, có những tin nào vậy?
records.sql: SELECT id, title, company, location, source_url FROM clean_jobs WHERE role = 'AI Engineer' AND is_internship = true;

records.question: Có việc Data Analyst cho fresher ở TP.HCM không?
records.sql: SELECT id, title, company, location, source_url FROM clean_jobs WHERE role = 'Data Analyst' AND job_level = 'Fresher/Entry level' AND location ILIKE '%Ho Chi Minh City%'

records.question: Tìm giúp mình các vị trí AI Engineer ở Hà Nội.
records.sql: SELECT id, title, company, location, source_url FROM clean_jobs WHERE role = 'AI Engineer' AND location ILIKE '%Hanoi%'

records.question: Có job Data Engineer ở HCM yêu cầu Python không?
records.sql: SELECT id, title, company, location, source_url FROM clean_jobs WHERE role = 'Data Engineer' AND location ILIKE '%Ho Chi Minh City%' AND tech_stack ILIKE '%Python%'

records.question: Mình là fresher, có việc nào ở level Fresher không?
records.sql: SELECT id, title, company, location, source_url FROM clean_jobs WHERE job_level = 'Fresher/Entry level'

records.question: Tìm việc Machine Learning nhé, ở đâu cũng được.
records.sql: SELECT id, title, company, location, source_url FROM clean_jobs WHERE role = 'ML Engineer'

records.question: tim internship IT support o ha noi voi
records.sql: SELECT id, title, company, location, source_url FROM clean_jobs WHERE is_internship = true AND location ILIKE '%Hanoi%' AND (title ILIKE '%IT support%' OR description ILIKE '%IT support%')

records.question: Có việc Data Engineer nào dùng SQL không?
records.sql: SELECT id, title, company, location, source_url FROM clean_jobs WHERE role = 'Data Engineer' AND tech_stack ILIKE '%SQL%';

records.question: Cho mình xin mấy tin Data Analyst có Power BI.

records.question: Có job AI Engineer level Fresher không?

records.question: Tìm các vị trí yêu cầu cả Spark và Airflow.
records.sql: SELECT id, title, company, location, source_url FROM clean_jobs WHERE tech_stack ILIKE '%Spark%' AND tech_stack ILIKE '%Airflow%'

records.question: tim viec Data Analyst o Da Nang, minh khong tim internship
records.sql: SELECT id, title, company, location, source_url FROM clean_jobs WHERE role = 'Data Analyst' AND location ILIKE '%Da Nang%' AND is_internship = false

records.question: co vi tri Data Engineer cap Manager khong?
records.sql: SELECT id, title, company, location, source_url FROM clean_jobs WHERE role = 'Data Engineer' AND job_level = 'Manager'

records.question: tim viec co Python, uu tien internship nha
records.sql: SELECT id, title, company, location, source_url FROM clean_jobs WHERE tech_stack ILIKE '%Python%' ORDER BY is_internship DESC, created_on DESC NULLS LAST

records.question: Trong tháng 6/2026 có bao nhiêu việc làm AI ở TP.HCM?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM clean_jobs WHERE role = 'AI Engineer' AND location ILIKE '%Ho Chi Minh City%' AND created_on >= '2026-06-01' AND created_on < '2026-07-01'

records.question: Có bao nhiêu việc làm AI yêu cầu Python?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM clean_jobs WHERE role = 'AI Engineer' AND tech_stack ILIKE '%Python%';

records.question: AI o Ha Noi yeu cau Python co bao nhieu tin?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM clean_jobs WHERE role = 'AI Engineer' AND location ILIKE '%Hanoi%' AND tech_stack ILIKE '%Python%'

records.question: Hiện có bao nhiêu tin thực tập?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM clean_jobs WHERE is_internship = true;

records.question: Tháng 6/2026 hệ thống có thêm bao nhiêu tin Data Engineer?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM clean_jobs WHERE role = 'Data Engineer' AND created_on >= DATE '2026-06-01' AND created_on < DATE '2026-07-01'

records.question: Thống kê số tin theo từng job level giúp mình.
records.sql: SELECT job_level, COUNT(*) AS count FROM clean_jobs GROUP BY job_level

records.question: Có bao nhiêu tin tuyển dụng đã ghi mức lương, chia theo currency nhé.
records.sql: SELECT salary_currency, COUNT(*) AS count FROM clean_jobs WHERE salary_min IS NOT NULL OR salary_max IS NOT NULL GROUP BY salary_currency

records.question: Tìm giúp mình các tin Data Scientist mới nhất.
records.sql: SELECT id, title, company, location, source_url FROM clean_jobs WHERE role = 'Data Scientist' ORDER BY created_on DESC NULLS LAST;

records.question: han cuoi ung tuyen cua tin Data Analyst o TPHCM la ngay nao?
